verification: for file in F-Sy-H.plugin.zsh lib/*.zsh functions/* completions/* chroma/*; do zsh -f -n "$file"; done

report_fields.label: Theme and configuration
report_fields.description: The output of `fsh_theme --show` and every `zstyle ':fsh:config'` setting in effect.

report_fields.label: Chroma diagnostics
report_fields.description: When a command's highlighting is wrong, the output of `fsh_chroma doctor`.

report_fields.label: Terminal and other plugins
report_fields.description: `$TERM`, the terminal emulator, and every other ZLE plugin in load order, such as zsh-autosuggestions or zsh-history-substring-search.

report_fields.label: Zi diagnostics
report_fields.description: The output of `zi analytics` and `zi zstatus`.

report_fields.label: Ices and annexes
report_fields.description: Every `zi` command involved, with all of its ice modifiers, and the annexes loaded.

report_fields.label: When it fails
report_fields.description: At load, at unload, only with turbo (`wait`) loading, or during install, update or `zi self-update`; for the last three, the paths and URLs involved.

install: a system package, or the CMake helper with --install-zi

report_fields.label: Build environment
report_fields.description: Compiler and version, CMake version and generator, OS and architecture, and the vendored Zsh header revision (`git -C vendor/zsh rev-parse HEAD`).

report_fields.label: Module loading
report_fields.description: How the module was installed, the exact `zmodload` error if any, and whether it was rebuilt for the running Zsh after a Zsh upgrade.

version.note: zsh-lint has no `--version` flag: in the version field, give the release tag or commit you built, such as the `@` version passed to `go install`.

report_fields.label: Invocation
report_fields.description: The exact command line, including `--config`, `--no-config` or `--format`, and its exit code.

report_fields.label: Configuration
report_fields.description: The `zsh-lint.json` in effect (zsh-lint searches upward from each input).

report_fields.label: Report kind
report_fields.description: A false positive or missed finding (name the `[rule]` id), or a crash. Valid Zsh that fails to parse goes to the Parser gap form instead.
